Patch 1.3 is Coming October 30th!

The wait is over! ArcheAge Classic's unique twist on Erenor Eternal (Patch 3.5) is here, tailored to capture the essence of the game's best-loved features. We’re bringing you a new experience that honors the Classic feel by rolling back the unpopular changes in commerce and gearing—while still adding exciting new content!

Ancestral Skills

Unleash the full power of your class with Ancestral Skills! Experiment with element-attuned variations that let you personalize your build and express your unique playstyle. With more paths to explore, it’s never been easier to stand out in your class!

New Zones

Get ready to conquer new territory! Whalesong Harbor and Aegis Island are open for exploration, offering new events, PvP action, expanded housing zones, and even more farming opportunities. Dive into these zones and test your skills against other adventurers!

Bonuses for New, Returning, and Loyal Players

We’re making it easier than ever for all players to dive into the game! New and returning heroes can kick off their journey with the Hasla Emerald weapon line. As a thank-you to our loyal community, existing players will also receive special bonuses for their continued support. Plus, we’re running multiple post-launch events to boost everyone’s experience!

Additional custom content coming soon!

While this update focuses on core content adjusted to fit our vision, we have some pretty cool custom content that will be coming after our 1.3 update! You can expect new vocational tools, QoL changes to current weapon systems, and more! Lastly, be sure to keep your eyes to the skies, something mysterious is happening up there…

== Patch 1.3 is Coming October 30th! ==

The wait is over! ArcheAge Classic's unique twist on Erenor Eternal (Patch 3.5) is here, tailored to capture the essence of the game's best-loved features. We’re bringing you a new experience that honors the Classic feel by rolling back the unpopular changes in commerce and gearing—while still adding exciting new content!

== Ancestral Skills ==
Unleash the full power of your class with Ancestral Skills! Experiment with element-attuned variations that let you personalize your build and express your unique playstyle. With more paths to explore, it’s never been easier to stand out in your class!

== New Zones ==
Get ready to conquer new territory! Whalesong Harbor and Aegis Island are open for exploration, offering new events, PvP action, expanded housing zones, and even more farming opportunities. Dive into these zones and test your skills against other adventurers!

== Bonuses for New, Returning, and Loyal Players ==
We’re making it easier than ever for all players to dive into the game! New and returning heroes can kick off their journey with the Hasla Emerald weapon line. As a thank-you to our loyal community, existing players will also receive special bonuses for their continued support. Plus, we’re running multiple post-launch events to boost everyone’s experience!

== Additional custom content coming soon! ==
While this update focuses on core content adjusted to fit our vision, we have some pretty cool custom content that will be coming after our 1.3 update! You can expect new vocational tools, QoL changes to current weapon systems, and more! Lastly, be sure to keep your eyes to the skies, something mysterious is happening up there…
